## What is LifeWise?

LifeWise - AI Family Hub is a family management app built for family use: one mobile app where every member has a Family Hub card for health, finances, reminders, documents, Family Ledger, Family Location, and daily routines. Official site: [lifewiseee.com](https://www.lifewiseee.com). Google Play package: `com.lifewise`. App Store listing: [LifeWise - AI Family Hub](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lifewise-ai-family-hub/id6803865970) (slug `lifewise-ai-family-hub`).

## Why it is unique

- Family Hub is the hero: modules attach to a person, not to a personal to-do list.
- Caregiver escalation on missed reminders (member + connected caregivers).
- Bill Management (what is due) stays separate from Family Ledger (who paid, for whom).
- Family Location is consent-based, with pause in one tap.
- Health Monitoring can sync Apple Health / Health Connect / compatible wearables onto that member card.
- Smart Automation routes missed tasks and optional bill-to-ledger posting.

## Pricing (INR)

- Free: Rs. 0. 2 members, 3 modules each, 10 reminders, 7 days history, 5 WiseAI messages/month
- Starter: Rs. 99/month or Rs. 799/year (33% off). 4 members, 8 modules, 50 reminders
- Family (recommended): Rs. 199/month or Rs. 1,499/year (37% off). Unlimited members, all 20 modules, Money Leak, location up to 6, PDF reports
- Pro: Rs. 499/month or Rs. 3,999/year. Unlimited documents, 300 WiseAI messages, medicine interaction checker, 5 sub-accounts
- Listed currency is INR. The website pricing section can display USD, EUR, and GBP converted from INR using ECB rates. App stores bill in the user's store currency.
